One stout mahogany table covered with a very dingy green cloth, variegated with figures of gentlemen in hunting costumes, dogs, and birds as large as the men; four dusky looking chairs, from the seats of which the horsehair bulged in various places; one discrepant sofa, a well used drugget, a ricketty cheffonier upon which were ranged a few medical books, two meerschaum pipes, an instrument case, and a pair of boxing gloves; one green flower stand, with the paint much peeled off, containing one solitary myrtle pot: such were the articles of use.
